00025 /*
00026  * memory settings for creating MrSID decoders
00027  *
00028  * "Small", "medium", and "large" refer to how much memory the
00029  * decoder will use when opening the image and constructing certain
00030  * internal data structures and tables.  In general, decode
00031  * performance will increase if more memory can be used.
00032  */
00033 enum MrSIDMemoryUsage
00034 {
00035    MRSID_MEMORY_USAGE_INVALID    = 0,
00036    MRSID_MEMORY_USAGE_DEFAULT    = 1,
00037    MRSID_MEMORY_USAGE_SMALL      = 2,
00038    MRSID_MEMORY_USAGE_MEDIUM     = 3,
00039    MRSID_MEMORY_USAGE_LARGE      = 4
00040 };
00041 
00042 /*
00043  * stream settings for creating MrSID decoders
00044  *
00045  * Normally, the stream used by the decoder is
00046  * only opened when doing actual decode work, as resources like
00047  * file handles can be a scarce resource in some environments.  This
00048  * obviously incurs a performance penalty; the "KeepStreamOpen" modes
00049  * can be used to change the behaviour.
00050  */
00051 enum MrSIDStreamUsage
00052 {
00053    MRSID_STREAM_USAGE_INVALID    = 0,
00054    MRSID_STREAM_USAGE_KEEPOPEN   = 2,
00055    MRSID_STREAM_USAGE_KEEPCLOSED = 3,
00056    MRSID_STREAM_USAGE_DEFAULT    = MRSID_STREAM_USAGE_KEEPCLOSED
00057 };
